title: Blucon can not pair at a standalone smartwatch and an android tablet  #255
symptom: Blucon cannot pair at a standalone smartwatch and an android tablet. The user reports that when pairing via xDrip, it says wrong PIN even when entered correctly, and the smartwatch tries to bond simultaneously in xDrip and Bluetooth settings.
evidence_quote: if i go first at xdrip and do bluetooth scan i insert the blucon's pin and then it tries to paired automatically and says at xdrip screen meny wrong pin even i insert it correctly.
